author: iDiamondPorkchop
body:
Alright, before you go "ah, this DiamondPorkchop3 guy again, just read this."
  
   In the time away I've been from Avicus, I've become a much better person. In the few months I've been away, I've tried the Overcast Network. While there, I've remembered the error of my ways on the Avicus Network and I've committed myself to becoming a better person. I've become much more mature and now I'm not saying rude things, and I've become much more mature. I play different servers, but Avicus is where all my memories have been. I've loved this server forever. I have made many great friends, and there are awesome staff. However, in the past I have been extremely immature, and I was very rude, mean, and I never did the right thing. But I have matured more now and I ask to be unbanned. You might think infractions might speak for my personality, but you are wrong. I have 100% changed. I'm a better person now. If I get back, I will always do the right thing. I will help everyone in every little way. You will never see me again doing anything wrong, I promise with all my heart. I know all my wrongs and infractions don't make a right, and I hope you understand. This was always my favorite server, and it disgusts me what a jerk I was back then. But if you let me come back, I will be the BEST person I can be. (Right hand put up)
I will never spam, or flood the chat. I shall not use vulgar language. I will never say "noob, eZ, or rekt." I will always do the right thing. You have my word on this. You have given me many chances back then, and being the jerk I was, I blew them. But now that I have changed, I will not blow the chance you may or may not offer me. Promise me, if you do, you will not regret it. Please let me come back to Avicus; to all my friends, memories, and great games and maps. There is nothing like Avicus, it is one of a kind. I hope you understand and will let me come back. You will not regret it.     Many Regards, DiamondPorkchop3. Please understand me. :)

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: iDiamondPorkchop
replies.body:
By the way, in the past I have been granted permission to appeal here.
   
    The only holiday gift I want is to come back to Avicus. I miss everyone there and all the staff. I miss all the maps, and I deeply want to come back. Even though my chances are low, nothing stands in my way.
